# Recompete Radar

> Free tool for small government contractors: list the federal contracts in your NAICS code and state that end in the next 6 to 24 months, who holds them, how concentrated the market is, and when the follow-on is likely to be solicited. Public USAspending data, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
